text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines the details 
 equipment inspection steps I1, required for
horizontal volume displacement pump with rotating pistons, which 
 must be performed every 2 and 6 month as indicated by M2, M6 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam 
Power Station 2x210MW
Technical specification of these PUMP
No. of pump for every unit | 4 ( PE 11,12,13,14)D001
Pump type | SIGMA 100 RPS- 1600-101-LN
Gear pox type | TSA 031301 03 3 5.6 x 1500
Delivered quantity (L/S) | 8.01
Pressure in delivery (Mpa) | 1
Pump speed (rpm) | 360
Recommended oil type for pumps gear box | DTE 105
Equivalent oil type for pumps gear box | Misr compressor oil 50
Quantity of oil for pumps gear box (L) | 2
Exchange interval for pumps gear box (hr) | 2000
Recommended oil type for main gear box | Mobil gear oil 630
Equivalent oil type for main gear box | Misr industrial gear oil p - 220
Quantity of oil for main gear box (L) | 2
Exchange interval for main gear box (hr) | 2000
Flexible coupling type | BKN-250 (Between pumps shaft and out gearbox
shaft).
 BKN 160 (Between motor shaft and in gearbox shaft).
Pump, gear box, motor shaft Diameter (mm) | ( 63 , 85 42 , 55 ) H7
Set weight (Kg) | 650
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and 
delivery valve.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and 
delivery valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Feeler gauge.
Suitable lifting device.
Work
to be Carried Out
Inspection every 2 
month
Before isolated the pump mechanically and electrically
Steps | Work to be carried out | Setting value | Test results
1 | Check any noise or vibration in pump, pump gearbox and main 
 gear box. | OK NOT OK | 
2 | Check any leakage from the piping connections to the pump. | OK NOT OK | 
3 | Check the amount of leakage from stuffing box and prevented 
 it by retighten the gland bolts | OK NOT OK | 
4 | Check any leakage of lubricating oil in pump gearbox | OK NOT OK | 
5 | Check any leakage of lubricating oil in main gearbox | OK NOT OK | 
6 | Check the oil level in pump gearbox. | OK NOT OK | 
7 | Check the oil level in main gearbox. | OK NOT OK | 
8 | Check the pressure in the pumps delivery. | OK NOT OK | 
9 | Check the temperature of all bearing houses | < 70 c | 
Notes:
After isolated the pump mechanically and electrically
Steps | Work to be carried out | Setting value | Test results
1 | Check the coupling pins and changed the inserts of carrying 
 pins (polyamide) if needed. | OK NOT OK | 
2 | Check the packing if there is more and did not prevent by 
 tighten the gland bolts | OK NOT OK | 
3 | Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil in pumps gearbox. | OK NOT OK | 
4 | Prevent leakage of lubricating oil in main gearbox. | OK NOT OK | 
5 | Add lubricating oil to main gearbox if oil level less than 
 2/3 oil side glass | 2/3 oil side glass | 
6 | Add lubricating oil to pumps gearbox if oil level less than 
 2/3 oil side glass. | 2/3 oil side glass | 
7 | Retighten the bolts connected pump, pumps gearbox, main 
 gearbox and motor with foundation. | OK NOT OK | 
8 | Check the alignment between pump, main gearbox and main 
 gearbox, motor | OK NOT OK |

Inspection every 6 month
Before isolated the pump mechanically and electrically
Steps | Work to be carried out | Setting value | Test results
1 | Check any noise or vibration in pump , pumps 
 gear box and main gear box | OK NOT OK | 
2 | Check the amount of leakage from stuffing box 
 and minimized it by retighten the gland bolts and keep some drops for 
 cooling. | OK NOT OK | 
3 | Check any leakage from the pipes connections to 
 the pump | OK NOT OK | 
4 | Check leakage of lubricating oil in pumps 
 gearbox | OK NOT OK | 
5 | Check leakage of lubricating oil in main 
 gearbox. | OK NOT OK | 
6 | Check the oil level in pumps gearbox | 2/3 oil side glass | 
7 | Check the oil level in main gearbox. | 2/3 oil side glass | 
8 | Check the pressure in the pumps delivery | 0.6 Mpa | 
9 | Check the temperature of all bearing house, it 
 must be less than 70 C. | < 70 c | 
Notes:
After isolated the pump mechanically and electrically
Steps | Work to be carried out | Setting value | Test results
1 | Check the rotating pistons from mechanical wear 
 and measure the clearances | OK NOT OK | 
2 | Check the bearings in pump , pumps gearbox | OK NOT OK | 
3 | Change the packing if leakage is heavy and 
 didnt prevented by tighten the gland bolts. | OK NOT OK | 
4 | Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil in pumps 
 gearbox and main gearbox | OK NOT OK | 
5 | Change the lubricating oil in pumps and main 
 gearbox. | OK NOT OK | 
6 | Check the couplings pins and changed the 
 inserts of carrying pins (Polyamide) if needed | OK NOT OK | 
7 | Check the alignment between pump main gearbox 
 and main gearbox motor. | OK NOT OK | 
8 | Retighten all bolts connected pump, pumps 
 gearbox, main gearbox and motor with foundation | OK NOT OK |
